errors.quote: butterflies compute the [Discrete Fourier transform](dft.md) of $z$ in $\log_2 t$ layers. The transform is $(F_tz)_m=\frac1t\sum_{j=0}^{t-1} z_j\omega_t^{-jm}$, where $\omega_t=e^{2\pi i/t}$ ... multiplies the two differences by $1$ and $\omega_4^{-1}=-i$
errors.problem: The page sets the butterfly recursion over complex numbers with $\omega_t=e^{2\pi i/t}$. In the paper (lines 2796-2845) the butterfly procedure computes the synthetic transform $F_t^-$ over $\mathcal R_r=\mathbb C[y]/(y^r+1)$ with $\omega_t=y^{2r/t}$ for $t\mid 2r$, so each twiddle $\omega_t^{-k}$ is a signed shift and $\omega_4^{-1}=y^{-r/2}$, not $-i$. The derivation still holds, because it uses only $\omega_t^{t/2}=-1$ and $\omega_t^2=\omega_{t/2}$, and both are true for $y^{2r/t}$. But the page never makes this connection, even though its second paragraph speaks of signed shifts. The complex formula does match the paper's separate $F_q$ (line 3508).
